alt: The Preface poses the question of granting autonomy to commodity intelligence. A vertical sequence leads through Chapter 1, The New Engineering Problem; Chapters 2 through 5, Modeling, Alignment, MAGE in Motion, and DocAble Among Other Software Factories; Chapter 6, The Theory; Chapter 7, The Profession; and the Conclusion, asking what cannot be delegated. A gray enclosure groups Chapters 2 through 5 as the software-engineering case. Below the Conclusion, dashed lines without arrowheads identify two separate reference destinations: Appendix A, Engineering Blueprints, and Appendix B, Practicing MAGE.
